text.description_html:
Acorn AKxBP, Black Stainless Steel Bean Tip Shutter Hinge

Acorn's Bean Tip Shutter Hinge features an old world design that is perfect for traditional homes. The black finish only heightens the sense of antiquity, making it perfect for historic home restoration projects or if you just want to add a bit of rustic beauty. Made out of stainless steel, it comes packaged with one hinge, one pintle, and matching fasteners. Hinges are reversible and available in two offsets and in three sizes, so you'll find the right fit.

Features and Specifications of the Bean Tip Shutter Hinge:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Reversible
  • Packaged Includes: 1 hinge, pintle and stainless steel screws.
  • Lifetime No Rust Warranty

    • Available Sizes:

      AKFBP
      • Length: 13-3/8"
      • Flush
      • Adjustable Pintle

      AKGBP
      • Length: 13"
      • Offset: 1-1/4"
      • Adjustable Pintle

      AKHBP
      • Length: 12-1/4"
      • Offset: 2-1/4"
      • Adjustable Pintle

      AKKBP
      • Length: 13"
      • Offset: 1-1/4"

      AKLBP
      • Length: 12-1/4
      • Offset: 2-1/4:

      AKJBP
      • Length: 13-3/8"
      • Flush

    Sold Individually (1 hinge). Recommended 2 hinges per shutter so 4 hinges per window.
